The rule is one line in Servex/agents/policy.js: an agent classed as a worker may spawn only minions and helpers, and the voice mastermind is classed as a worker. The fix lands on its branch; I restart Servex once it does, and the page mastermind and AI mastermind spawn as real masterminds from then on.

Live since the 20:10 restart: a voice mastermind may now spawn real masterminds (the page mastermind and the AI mastermind). The tunnel is up and answers. Note that the connector now lists the full Servex tool set, per your earlier grant; a risk note about the lock on that door is pinned in your inbox.
